faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ordering custom packaging from Skat Print.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Minimum order quantities depend on the product type and configuration. For standard corrugated boxes and packaging, we typically work from 500 units upward. For custom or specialty packaging, we accept smaller runs, contact us with your specification for a precise answer.

items.question: What is the typical production lead time?
items.answer: Standard orders are fulfilled within 10–15 working days from approved design. Custom orders requiring new die-cutting tooling may require 15–20 working days. Rush production is available for select order types, ask when requesting your quote.

items.question: Can you produce non-standard sizes and shapes?
items.answer: Yes. We produce packaging in any dimension with no minimum standard size. Our in-house die-cutting capacity allows for unlimited custom shapes, structural cutouts, and bespoke configurations.

items.question: What printing methods do you use?
items.answer: We use offset printing on Roland (52×74cm) and Heidelberg (71×102cm) presses, the same technology used for high-quality commercial printing. This gives significantly sharper results than flexographic printing on corrugated cardboard.

items.question: Do you offer design and pre-press support?
items.answer: Yes. Our in-house design team can work from your brand guidelines, existing artwork, or brief. We handle file preparation, structural dieline creation, and pre-press for all orders.

items.question: Do you offer packaging consultation?
items.answer: Yes. Our team can advise on material choice, structural design, and finish options based on your product, budget, and shelf requirements before you commit to a spec. Get in touch to discuss your project.

items.question: What materials and finishes are available?
items.answer: We work with corrugated cardboard (N, E, B wave and 5-layer), cardboard, and microcorrugated. Available finishes include matte laminate, gloss laminate, silver foil, gold foil, and embossing. All materials are 100% recyclable.

items.question: Do you hold any sustainability certifications?
items.answer: We don't currently hold formal third-party certifications such as ISO or FSC. All our materials are 100% recyclable and contain no harmful substances, and our production line was upgraded through an EU-co-funded energy-efficiency investment. Contact us if you need specific compliance documentation for your market.

items.question: What are your delivery options?
items.answer: We deliver across Bulgaria and export throughout Europe. Delivery method and timing are arranged per order based on volume, packaging type, and destination. Contact us with your location for specifics.

case_studies.problem: A 40,000-unit run was approved with packaging specs, then a rebrand changed the brief three weeks before the production deadline.
case_studies.constraint: No timeline extension was possible — the product was already committed to retail planograms for Q3.
case_studies.solution: Skat Print restructured the print schedule, re-plated the new artwork within 48 hours, and prioritised the run across two shifts.
case_studies.result: Full 40,000-unit run delivered on the original date. Zero compromises on print quality or material spec.

case_studies.problem: A distributor needed corrugated transit boxes that met Austrian retailer shelf-audit requirements and carried FSC Chain of Custody certification.
case_studies.constraint: The client had previously failed audits with two other suppliers on substrate certification documentation.
case_studies.solution: Skat Print supplied FSC-certified corrugated board from its in-house production line and provided full chain-of-custody documentation for each delivery.
case_studies.result: First-time audit pass at all three retail partners. Reorder placed within 60 days.

case_studies.problem: A 15-SKU seasonal POS display campaign needed to roll out across 80 store locations simultaneously within a 10-day window.
case_studies.constraint: Each store required a different SKU mix, and the chain's logistics team could not manage split deliveries.
case_studies.solution: Skat Print produced and pre-sorted all 15 SKU display units into store-specific pallet configurations before dispatch.
case_studies.result: All 80 stores set up within the 10-day window. Zero mis-picks reported.

food_packaging.meta_description: Custom corrugated and cardboard food packaging for EU food brands. FSC-certified materials, food-grade production, shelf-ready boxes. B2B manufacturer since 1995.
food_packaging.hero_headline: Food-Grade Packaging Built for Europe's Shelves
food_packaging.hero_subheadline: Corrugated and cardboard food packaging that meets EU food-contact standards, survives the supply chain, and performs on retail shelves.
food_packaging.intro: Food brands face a packaging brief that most manufacturers struggle with: structural integrity for transit, compliance with EU food-contact regulations, shelf appeal, and FSC-certification requirements — all at a price that works for your margin. Since 1995, Skat Print has supplied corrugated and cardboard packaging to food manufacturers, distributors, and private-label brands across Europe. Our in-house corrugated board production means we control substrate quality from the first layer, not just the print stage.

food_packaging.process_heading: How a Food Packaging Order Works

process_steps.title: Brief & Specification
process_steps.desc: Share your dimensions, weight requirements, print artwork, and any retail compliance specifications. We review and confirm substrate suitability.

process_steps.title: Technical Review
process_steps.desc: Our team runs compression and stacking tests on the proposed spec. For shelf-ready designs, we confirm retailer planogram compatibility.

process_steps.title: Sample Approval
process_steps.desc: We produce a pre-production sample. You approve the print, structure, and finish before full production begins.

process_steps.title: Production & Delivery
process_steps.desc: Standard lead time is 10–15 business days. We ship in coordinated batches for multi-SKU orders across EU destinations.

use_cases: Supermarket shelf-ready cases for snack, dairy, and beverage brands
E-commerce outer boxes for direct-to-consumer food subscription brands
Bulk transit packaging for food processors and co-packers
Gift and seasonal food hamper boxes with premium finish
Private-label outer cases for retail chains across the EU

faq.q: Are your food packaging materials EU food-contact compliant?
faq.a: Yes. All food-contact packaging we produce uses substrates that comply with EU Regulation 1935/2004 on food contact materials. We can provide compliance documentation on request.

faq.q: Can you supply FSC-certified food packaging?
faq.a: Yes. Skat Print holds FSC Chain of Custody certification. All food packaging orders can be produced on FSC-certified corrugated board, with full documentation provided per delivery.

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity for food packaging?
faq.a: Minimum order quantities start at 500 units for standard corrugated cases. For shelf-ready packaging with die-cut perforations, minimums are typically 1,000 units depending on complexity.

faq.a: Yes. We produce the outer corrugated packaging for Bag-in-Box formats including 2L, 3L, 5L, and 10L. The outer can be plain or custom offset-printed with up to six colours.

faq.q: Can you produce wine packaging for small wineries with low MOQs?
faq.a: Yes. We work with boutique wineries from 2,000-unit runs. Minimum quantities depend on the format — carriers and gift boxes typically start from 500–1,000 units.

faq.q: What print and finish options are available for luxury spirits packaging?
faq.a: Our offset presses produce up to six colours. We apply gold foil, silver foil, matte, and gloss lamination in-house, giving spirits brands the premium surface quality the category demands.

retail_pos_displays.intro: Point-of-sale displays are among the highest-ROI packaging investments a retail brand can make. A well-executed floor stand can outsell the adjacent shelf position by 2–4× in the first week. We design and produce corrugated floor displays, counter units, pallet skirts, PDQ trays, and shelf talkers for retail chains, FMCG brand owners, and distributors across Europe. Our in-house die-cutting and offset printing means we can produce structural prototypes quickly and scale to full campaign volumes without outsourcing.

process_steps.title: Retail Brief
process_steps.desc: Share your retail chain specifications, floor placement zone, product weight per unit, and campaign timeline. We review structural requirements.

process_steps.title: Structural Design
process_steps.desc: Our team produces a structural dieline optimised for your product load, shipping flat-pack efficiency, and in-store assembly time.

process_steps.title: Prototype & Load Test
process_steps.desc: A physical prototype is produced and load-tested before sign-off. For chain roll-outs, we confirm compliance with retailer floor-placement guidelines.

process_steps.title: Production & Store Delivery
process_steps.desc: We batch and sort production by store configuration for multi-location campaigns. Flat-pack delivery with simple pop-up assembly for store staff.

faq.q: Can you produce displays compliant with specific retail chain floor guidelines?
faq.a: Yes. We work to retailer floor placement specifications including load requirements, dimension constraints, and base pad configurations. Share the chain's supplier guidelines and we'll design to compliance.

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity for POS displays?
faq.a: Minimum orders start at 50 units for floor displays and 100 units for counter PDQ trays. For multi-store roll-outs, we can produce and sort by store from 200 units upward.

faq.q: Do you deliver POS displays pre-assembled or flat-pack?
faq.a: We deliver flat-pack for efficient transport and in-store assembly. All displays are designed for fast pop-up assembly by store staff, typically under 5 minutes per unit.
